tool_args.rationale: The bridge-epidemic and flux-conservation signatures point toward a siphon mechanism, but the observed rows vary only u_now and hold s_grad fixed. The branch sign and gradient-dependent response remain ambiguous, so the targeted open-branch probe is warranted.

considered_alternatives.option: author a static two-layer siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five rows have identical s_grad, so sink inhibition and the open branch cannot be identified from the current design.
The observations do not indicate coupled memory dynamics; this higher-cost batch is not the targeted ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to distinguishing the plausible mechanisms and should not be purchased.
